item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 04/Dec/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a strong easterly airstream, the weather will be mainly fine over the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. A dry northeast monsoon will reach the coast of southern China over the weekend. It will be cool in the morning over the region early next week. With the monsoon moderating midweek next week, temperatures over Guangdong will rise slightly. Another surge of the northeast monsoon is expected to affect southern China in the latter part of next week.
